standardization.reference_weights: reference stratum matches / total reference matches; do not round before computing
standardization.missing_positive_reference_cell: retain target and direct description; standardized estimate empty with status unsupported_positive_reference_layer; no implicit restriction or imputation

output_contract.counts: nonnegative integers; authoritative numerators and denominators
output_contract.difference: arm1 minus arm2; probability difference and percentage-point difference=100*delta
output_contract.undefined: empty numeric value plus status and reason; never NaN/Infinity or zero substitute
output_contract.reproducibility: fixed inputs/config/code => same core CSV bytes; run metadata may differ
output_contract.core_version_binding: analysis_id in each core CSV; remaining versions in immutable analysis_metadata.json, linked by analysis_id
output_contract.run_identity_binding: run_id and time only in run_manifest; not core tables
output_contract.zero_reference_weight_layer: retain counts; skip weighted term without evaluating undefined rate; positive weight missing arm => unsupported
output_contract.contrast_identifier: contrast_id separate from target_id; multiple contrasts can use one multigroup target

inference.multiple_comparison_scope: 25个分区总体率差+2欧亚关系差+1南美汇总差；南美关系另只描述。155条件率格不是155独立检验。第四问另定联合检验。
inference.classification_sensitivity: Q4 explicitly revisit carrier/boundary assumptions; do not change groups after observing outcome

terminology.method_definition: 依据M49最深非空层级构建互不重叠的统计地理分区，并保留M49原始层级
terminology.central_europe: M49无单独中欧；不新建第五组，常见中欧国家明确列出现有归属，未来改用五分区须另立协议

multigroup_contract.group_rates: Compute every configured group once under one target-specific reference
multigroup_contract.pairwise: Only predeclared pairs; European four groups include all six unordered pairs
multigroup_contract.direction: Fixed by contrast_id arms, never chosen from results
multigroup_contract.missing_support: Keep all groups; invalidate only unsupported group rates and affected pairs; preserve target and reference
multigroup_contract.overall_inference: Deferred to Q4, including joint covariance and multiple comparisons; no independent-samples ANOVA assumed

study_classification.basis: M49-based project groups with explicitly requested football-context exceptions; not a complete confederation classification
